title: horsefly — onstage

sentences.sentence: That horsefly is the only thing keeping this old horse moving.
sentences.translation: 那只马蝇是唯一能让这匹老马活动的东西。

sentences.sentence: We represent the last vestige of what made this nation great – hard work.
sentences.translation: 我们代表了曾经使这个国家伟大的仅存的品质–勤奋。

sentences.sentence: His cane answered for a baseball bat.
sentences.translation: 他的手杖可代用棒球棒。

sentences.sentence: Dick fell for baseball when he was a little boy.
sentences.translation: 当迪克还是个小孩时，他就迷恋上了棒球运动。

sentences.sentence: They came to the baseball field to root for their school team.
sentences.translation: 他们来到棒球场为他们的校队鼓劲。

sentences.sentence: He spoke reverently about colleges and loved walking around the Stanford campus.
sentences.translation: 他虔诚地谈到大学，说自己喜欢在斯坦佛校园漫步。

sentences.sentence: As the store clerk reverently lifted the object out of the case, I knew it would be too small.
sentences.translation: 当店员恭敬地从柜台里取出这个物品时，我知道它肯定太小了。

sentences.sentence: There, many thousands of years ago, a nameless people reverently buried their loved ones.
sentences.translation: 就在数千年前的此地，一群无名无姓的人虔诚地埋葬了他们所深爱的人。

translations.translation: 无家的, 无家可归的

sentences.sentence: Thousands of people have been made homeless .
sentences.translation: 成千上万人被逼得无家可归。

sentences.sentence: Her disappearance has mystified her friends and neighbors.
sentences.translation: 她的失踪使她的朋友和邻居迷惑不解。

sentences.sentence: shows aimed at large undifferentiated groups of people
sentences.translation: 针对不加以细分的大众的节目

sentences.sentence: Colonial officials tended to see Indian society as an undifferentiated whole.
sentences.translation: 殖民地官员往往把印度社会看成一个统一整体。

translations.translation: 地心吸力, 引力作用

sentences.sentence: Newton’s law of gravitation
sentences.translation: 牛顿万有引力定律

sentences.sentence: Flowers bloom in springtime.
sentences.translation: 花在春天开放。

sentences.sentence: At springtime this river always overruns.
sentences.translation: 每到春天这条河总会泛滥。

sentences.sentence: Which is why, at a price, we still have Paris in springtime.
sentences.translation: 这也是今天我们（付出代价后）在巴黎仍能享受春天的原因。

phrases.translation: 雪橇犬；雪橇狗；拉雪橇的狗

sentences.sentence: She tumbled over a sled.
sentences.translation: 她被雪橇绊了一跤。

sentences.sentence: When his sled broke down, he repaired it.
sentences.translation: 当他的雪橇坏掉时，他自己维修。

sentences.sentence: The hut stands at the foot of a near vertical wall of rock in an icy fjord in the high Arctic, a week away by dog sled from the nearest human settlement.
sentences.translation: 小屋坐落在高纬度北极地区峡湾边一座几乎是垂直的山岩下，从最近的有人居住的地方到此地，狗拉的雪橇要走一个星期。

phrases.translation: 跳台滑雪（滑雪运动项目之一）

sentences.sentence: ski slopes
sentences.translation: 滑雪坡

sentences.sentence: a ski resort (= where people can go skiing )
sentences.translation: 滑雪度假胜地

sentences.sentence: Alternatively, the dead could have been killed on the spot in "the swampy valley environment", the paper concludes.
sentences.translation: 另一种可能是，这些死者是在有“沼泽河谷环境”的地点被杀害的——论文总结道。

sentences.sentence: On rare clearings in this swampy hell a few Finno-Ugric tribes eventually appeared and left many burial mounts behind, with some of them still belowground because of impassibility of the swamp.
sentences.translation: 在这难得如此空旷的沼泽地狱里，几个芬兰乌戈尔部落终于出现了，身后留下了许多坟墓，其中有些还是地下，因为的沼泽是那么不近人情。

sentences.sentence: He advanced towards the angle, and summoning all his resolution, attacked the ground with the pickaxe.
sentences.translation: 他向那个角落走去好象突然下了一个很大的决心似的，用鹤嘴锄猛击地面。

sentences.sentence: The pickaxe struck for a moment with a dull sound that drew out of Dantès' forehead large drops of perspiration.
sentences.translation: 鹤嘴锄最初敲上去时只发出了一声沉重浑浊的声音，那种声音使唐太斯的前额挂满了大滴的冷汗。

sentences.translation: 引擎汽缸的容积

sentences.translation: 贝克抗辩说他的审判受到了负面宣传的影响。

translations.translation: 引起瘟疫的, 有害的

sentences.sentence: ...people who were dependent for their water supply on this pestilential stream.
sentences.translation: ...那些靠这条致病的河流来取水的人们。

sentences.translation: 直到今天我上舞台前还是会感到紧张。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 392 单元

horsefly
音标：英 /'hɔːsflaɪ/  美 /'hɔrsflaɪ/
n. 马蝇
例句：That horsefly is the only thing keeping this old horse moving.
那只马蝇是唯一能让这匹老马活动的东西。

nonelectronic
adj. 非电子的

vestige
音标：英 /'vestɪdʒ/  美 /'vɛstɪdʒ/
n. 痕迹
例句：We represent the last vestige of what made this nation great – hard work.
我们代表了曾经使这个国家伟大的仅存的品质–勤奋。

baseball
音标：英 /'beɪsbɔːl/  美 /'besbɔl/
n. 棒球(运动)
短语：baseball game — 棒球比赛
短语：baseball team — 棒球队；棒球队型
短语：baseball player — 棒球运动员；棒球选手
短语：baseball cap — 棒球帽
短语：baseball bat — 棒球棒
短语：major league baseball — （美）职业棒球大联盟
短语：baseball glove — 棒球手套
短语：baseball diamond — 棒球内场
例句：His cane answered for a baseball bat.
他的手杖可代用棒球棒。
例句：Dick fell for baseball when he was a little boy.
当迪克还是个小孩时，他就迷恋上了棒球运动。
例句：They came to the baseball field to root for their school team.
他们来到棒球场为他们的校队鼓劲。

reverently
adv. 恭敬地, 虔诚地
例句：He spoke reverently about colleges and loved walking around the Stanford campus.
他虔诚地谈到大学，说自己喜欢在斯坦佛校园漫步。
例句：As the store clerk reverently lifted the object out of the case, I knew it would be too small.
当店员恭敬地从柜台里取出这个物品时，我知道它肯定太小了。
例句：There, many thousands of years ago, a nameless people reverently buried their loved ones.
就在数千年前的此地，一群无名无姓的人虔诚地埋葬了他们所深爱的人。

homeless
音标：英 /'həʊmlɪs/  美 /'homləs/
adj. 无家的, 无家可归的
例句：Thousands of people have been made homeless .
成千上万人被逼得无家可归。

mystify
音标：英 /'mɪstɪfaɪ/  美 /'mɪstə'fai/
v. 迷惑
例句：Her disappearance has mystified her friends and neighbors.
她的失踪使她的朋友和邻居迷惑不解。

mesmerize
音标：英 /'mezməraiz, 'mes-/  美 /'mɛzməraɪz/
v. 施催眠术

undifferentiated
音标：英 /,ʌndɪfə'renʃɪeɪtɪd/  美 /'ʌndɪfə'rɛnʃɪ'etɪd/
adj. 无差别的, 一致的
例句：shows aimed at large undifferentiated groups of people
针对不加以细分的大众的节目
例句：Colonial officials tended to see Indian society as an undifferentiated whole.
殖民地官员往往把印度社会看成一个统一整体。

gravitation
音标：英 /grævɪ'teɪʃ(ə)n/  美 /,ɡrævɪ'teʃən/
n. 地心吸力, 引力作用
短语：universal gravitation — 万有引力
例句：Newton’s law of gravitation
牛顿万有引力定律

springtime
音标：英 /'sprɪŋtaɪm/  美 /'sprɪŋ'taɪm/
n. 春天, 春季
例句：Flowers bloom in springtime.
花在春天开放。
例句：At springtime this river always overruns.
每到春天这条河总会泛滥。
例句：Which is why, at a price, we still have Paris in springtime.
这也是今天我们（付出代价后）在巴黎仍能享受春天的原因。

sled
音标：英 /sled/  美 /slɛd/
n. (小)雪撬
短语：sled dog — 雪橇犬；雪橇狗；拉雪橇的狗
例句：She tumbled over a sled.
她被雪橇绊了一跤。
例句：When his sled broke down, he repaired it.
当他的雪橇坏掉时，他自己维修。
例句：The hut stands at the foot of a near vertical wall of rock in an icy fjord in the high Arctic, a week away by dog sled from the nearest human settlement.
小屋坐落在高纬度北极地区峡湾边一座几乎是垂直的山岩下，从最近的有人居住的地方到此地，狗拉的雪橇要走一个星期。

ski
音标：英 /skiː/  美 /ski/
n. 滑雪板 vi滑雪
短语：ski resort — 滑雪胜地
短语：water ski — 滑水橇
短语：ski jumping — 跳台滑雪（滑雪运动项目之一）
短语：ski pole — 滑雪杖
短语：ski jump — 跳台滑雪
短语：jet ski — 喷气式滑雪板或滑橇
短语：ski suit — 滑雪服
例句：ski slopes
滑雪坡
例句：a ski resort (= where people can go skiing )
滑雪度假胜地

swampy
音标：英 /'swɒmpɪ/  美 /'swɔmpi/
adj. 沼泽的，似沼泽的
例句：Alternatively, the dead could have been killed on the spot in "the swampy valley environment", the paper concludes.
另一种可能是，这些死者是在有“沼泽河谷环境”的地点被杀害的——论文总结道。
例句：On rare clearings in this swampy hell a few Finno-Ugric tribes eventually appeared and left many burial mounts behind, with some of them still belowground because of impassibility of the swamp.
在这难得如此空旷的沼泽地狱里，几个芬兰乌戈尔部落终于出现了，身后留下了许多坟墓，其中有些还是地下，因为的沼泽是那么不近人情。

pickaxe
音标：美 /'pɪkæks/
n. 鹤嘴锄, 手镐
例句：He advanced towards the angle, and summoning all his resolution, attacked the ground with the pickaxe.
他向那个角落走去好象突然下了一个很大的决心似的，用鹤嘴锄猛击地面。
例句：The pickaxe struck for a moment with a dull sound that drew out of Dantès' forehead large drops of perspiration.
鹤嘴锄最初敲上去时只发出了一声沉重浑浊的声音，那种声音使唐太斯的前额挂满了大滴的冷汗。

cubic
音标：英 /'kjuːbɪk/  美 /'kjubɪk/
adj. 立方体的, 立方的
短语：cubic spline — 三次样条；三次样条曲线（线图）；三次仿样函数
短语：cubic boron nitride — [材料学]立方氮化硼
短语：cubic meter — 立方米
短语：cubic feet — 立方英尺
短语：cubic zirconia — 立方氧化锆
短语：cubic polynomial — 三次多项式；立方次多项式
短语：cubic foot — 立方尺
短语：cubic equation — 三次方程
短语：cubic metre — 立方米
短语：cubic centimeter — 立方厘米
短语：cubic lattice — 立方晶格；立方格子；立方点阵
短语：cubic system — [化]等轴晶系；立方晶系
短语：cubic interpolation — 三次插值；三次内插
短语：cubic capacity — [建]立体容积
例句：the cubic capacity of an engine
引擎汽缸的容积

taint
音标：英 /teɪnt/  美 /tent/
v. 感染 n污点
例句：Baker argues that his trial was tainted by negative publicity.
贝克抗辩说他的审判受到了负面宣传的影响。

pestilential
音标：英 /,pestɪ'lenʃ(ə)l/  美 /,pɛstɪ'lɛnʃl/
adj. 引起瘟疫的, 有害的
例句：...people who were dependent for their water supply on this pestilential stream.
...那些靠这条致病的河流来取水的人们。

miasmic
adj. 毒气的, 瘴气的

onstage
音标：英 /ɒn'steɪdʒ/  美 /'ɔn'stedʒ/
adj. 台上的,舞台表演区的
例句：Even today I get nervous before I go onstage.
直到今天我上舞台前还是会感到紧张。
